impact.outOfTimeSeasons: 2015–2026, each rated on earlier seasons only
impact.label: CricField Runs Above Replacement. Not WAR: no conversion to wins has been validated.

auction.chosenModel: Average of ridge and gradient-boosted trees

retention.scope: Mini-auction continuation: does the franchise keep this player into the next season?

probabilityGate.rule: Holdout Brier below the base-rate Brier and expected calibration error at most 0.08

excluded.reason: Formal mega-auction retention follows different rules; only two comparable events are on file (2022, 2025), which cannot be validated out of time.

sold.note: Cross-validated inside a single auction. No earlier unsold lists are on file, so this has never been tested on a later auction.

seasonSimulationGate.rule: The 95% bootstrap interval of Brier skill on 2023–2026 matches must lie above zero

performance.rule: Chosen on next-season rank correlation over 2016–2023; 2024–2026 is reported, not used to choose.

aging.note: Runs per match change from one season to the next by age at the second season, relative to the average change at all ages (which is regression to the mean). Shrunk toward zero by n/(n+30).

decisionBacktest.note: Area under the ROC curve for ranking kept players above released ones, on the out-of-time retention decisions. 0.5 is chance.
